text:
Kavi: quick FYI — noticed a bump in unattributed quota rows after some TS/Go clients enabled the new compact routing header. Saw it during the daily quota sanity check.
Ruth: which header did the clients start sending?
Kavi: x-compact-route-v1 when opt-in=true. internal-proxy canonicalizer strips unknown headers, so console never receives routing metadata.
Ilya: ah, sounds like the same class of issue we've had before. Can we do a proxy-level mapping as a fast mitigation?
Tara: short term: yes. proxy can copy x-compact-route-v1 -> x-routing-hint and add x-routing-mapped: compact-v1. That preserves the payload and tags it.
Kavi: agree. I'd like the mapping to be reversible and visible in telemetry so we can audit. ops-bot: CR-8012 created for proxy mapping, owner required.
Ruth: SDK side: we should dual-write both headers for a compatibility window. Suggest dual-write for 8 weeks then remove legacy emission. Add x-route-compat: dual-write for detection.
Ilya: console changes to accept the new header will take a few sprints. Proxy shim + SDK dual-write is the practical path. Also emit metric routing.header.mapped{src:compact-v1} so we can monitor impact.
Tara: risk note: compact encoding includes sampling bits & affinity fingerprint. Mapping must not mutate TTLs or fingerprint bytes used by caches. We'll ensure copy-only.
Kavi: plan: 1) Implement proxy mapping patch (canary in us-west-2 in 25m) 2) add telemetry event routing.mapping with source tag 3) ship TS/Go SDK minor to dual-write 4) console parser PR to accept x-compact-route-v1 5) announce deprecation timeline 6) reconcile billing ledger after 48h.
Ruth: can we also have SDKs emit both headers with the legacy header marked x-route-origin: legacy to be explicit?
Ilya: yes, that helps analytics. Also, bake a dashboard that shows "mapped vs native" attribution by tenant and a small support filter.
Tara: I'll open the proxy PR and request a fast-track review. deploy-bot: proxy config v2026.8 queued for canary.
Kavi: test checklist for canary: a) unattributed rate returns to baseline b) affinity miss-rate unchanged c) no latency regressions d) mapping metric shows reasonable volume.
Ruth: communication: short banner on console and support playbook for tenants that might see differences. I'll draft the note after we verify canary.
ops-bot: scheduled canary window 25m-3h UTC for CR-8012.
Kavi: thanks all — keep updates here so we have a single thread for the change log. :thumbsup:
